_note: Bolt-on row, step B1 of the mod tree (2026-10-10). 26 cheap items, each changes one number or one sound, any order, fits every car (deltas are relative: mul/add on whatever the car has). Ops: ["mul", k], ["add", d], ["set", v] on a CarSpec key. 'effects' are levers the track sim cannot see (lamps, tow, heat, wear, fuel, sound): the worth sweep prices them from the 'street_model' below. 'est_worth' is the design estimate for the Bug (0-10); 'flair' (0-1) is the authored sound/info value that cannot be measured headless. Worth is measured by BoltOnWorth: Pace (0-5, 1 pt = 0.5 s on a 90 s reference loop) + Control (0-3, 1 pt = 10% fewer mistakes or 2 m in 100-0) + Street (0-3, 1 pt = 5% of an act-1 night's earnings) + flair, capped at 10. 'giftable' false = sound-only, never offered as a gift.

service.label: Service
service._note: The Bug 'after Service' = the mod tree's L0 node (garage proposal 2a): fresh plugs, no leaks, +4% torque. Every worth is measured on top of this.

loop._note: The ~90 s reference night loop: two standing 400 m runs (straights), six 90-degree bends of 50 m radius, and a fixed gap time for traffic that no part changes. The gap is worked out once from the Bug after Service so the loop starts at exactly 90 s.

control_model._note: Mistakes: the bendy-loop bot enters bends at a spread of speeds around 90% of the Bug's baseline slide-onset speed (first 12 degrees of slip on the corner run, steered hard enough that the car is grip-limited, BoltOnWorth.BEND_STEER). A mistake is entering above the car's own slide-onset speed. Spread is 10% of that speed.

street_model._note: ASSUMED act-1 night ledger, in nights of earnings (1.0 = one act-1 night, the garage proposal's unit). Stage C payouts are not measured yet; these are placeholders so the sweep can price the street items. Replace when payouts exist.

items.label: Iridium plugs
items.notice: A little more torque, shorter crank

items.label: Lightweight wheel nuts
items._note: No separate unsprung mass in the sim, so this is plain mass.

items.label: Shift light
items.notice: A lamp tells you when to change up
items._note: Measured as the average driver (shifts at 90% of redline) shifting at the car's own best upshift point, which the lamp shows.

items.label: Polyurethane bushings
items.notice: Steering answers faster, the cabin rattles

items.label: Drift handbrake
items.notice: The handbrake locks the rear harder
items._note: max_handbrake_force is re-derived from tyre friction when the car initialises, so this is a lever (handbrake_force_mul) for the car to read, not a spec key. The test bot never pulls the handbrake, so the sweep reports it unmeasured.
